interaction.claim: Differentiable hydrophobic-contact, idealized missing-valence-cone heavy-atom hydrogen-bond, screened formal-charge-group, aromatic, halogen-bond, and profile-dispatched metal-coordination guidance. All seven implemented terms are enabled in the user-requested diagnostic default. Metal attraction is admitted only for a standalone mononuclear site with a profile-supported identity, complete retained coordination shell, one resolved vacancy, and matching geometry; otherwise attraction fails closed while an explicitly profiled repulsion-only site remains traceable. This is a pose-guidance diagnostic, not explicit-hydrogen geometry, partial-charge electrostatics, solvation, affinity, free energy, or an external docking-score implementation.
